Cold-Chain Refrigeration Engineer said about it: As Cold-Chain Refrigeration Engineer, the field precedent for 1 tonne is the Ecofrost solar cold room holding 4 to 10 degrees Celsius with 5 kilowatt standalone solar and up to 30 hours batteryless backup (E16 Ecofrost - Solar Powered Cold Storage Room Manufacturer in India - Ecozen | Ecozensolutions), matched by the 3 metre by 3 metre by 2 metre ColdHubs store for up to 3 tonnes (E18 Cold Hubs | Engineering For Change), which together mean a small Direct Current (DC, battery-type power) variable-speed vapor-compression monoblock with forced air.
